translation: You make ⟨us⟩ a contention ⟨to⟩ our neighbors; and our enemies laugh among themselves.

tokens.rationale: Hiphil imperfect 2mp from אכל, literally 'you cause to eat', but idiomatically 'you make' here
Literal 'bread', but here metonymic for the object of contention; represents Israel being made a 'bread/food' for strife
Literally 'tears', but here understood as 'strife/contention' (JPS, BSB); the object of the laughter
Root unclear (possibly שוק 'to drink' or שקק 'to contend'); context requires 'to/among' neighbors
Literally 'in tears', but here likely 'among themselves' (cf. KJV, ASV, YLT); enclitic ב- prefix
Literally 'third' or 'triple'; here musical/metaphoric for 'in three parts' or 'together'
